mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.store_id, o.customer_id, o.user_id, o.user_name, o.item_count, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, o.pay_status, o.pay_method, o.pay_time, o.status, o.delivery_type, o.receiver, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.cancel_reason, o.cancel_time, o.remark, o.del_flag, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, s.store_name from pet_order o left join pet_store s on s.store_id = o.store_id
mapper.select: select item_id, order_id, order_no, item_type, pet_id, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, goods_spec, price, qty, amount, create_time from pet_order_item where order_no = #{orderNo} order by item_id asc

select item_id, order_id, order_no, item_type, pet_id, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, goods_spec, price, qty, amount, create_time from pet_order_item where order_id in #{id} order by item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into pet_order (order_no, order_type, store_id, customer_id, user_id, user_name, item_count, total_amount, pay_amount, pay_status, status, delivery_type, receiver, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{storeId}, #{customerId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{itemCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{payStatus}, #{status}, #{deliveryType}, #{receiver}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())

insert into pet_order_item (order_id, order_no, item_type, pet_id, goods_id, sku_id, goods_name, goods_image, goods_spec, price, qty, amount, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{itemType}, #{petId}, #{goodsId}, #{skuId}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImage}, #{goodsSpec}, #{price}, #{qty}, #{amount}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pet_order set pay_status = '1', pay_method = #{payMethod}, pay_time = sysdate(), status = (case when status = '0' then '1' else status end), update_time = sysdate() where order_no = #{orderNo} and pay_status = '0' and status <> '3'
mapper.select: select count(*) as cnt, ifnull(sum(case when pay_status = '1' then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as paid, ifnull(sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unpaid, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as toShip from pet_order where del_flag = '0' and store_id = #{storeId} and date(create_time) = #{date}
